_comment: Copy this file to scope-dimensions.json to switch row-level scopes on.
Each entry names a column an admin may scope a user against; the selectable
values are read from that column with SELECT DISTINCT, so the admin UI can
only ever offer values that exist in the data. 'database' is optional and
defaults to the connection's own. See src/auth/scopeService.js — the scopes
are stored and configurable but not yet applied to queries.
